q: Kazhdan's property (T) for a group Γ means:
opts: Every unitary representation with almost-invariant vectors has a nonzero invariant vector
Every subgroup of Γ has finite index
exp: Property (T) (Kazhdan 1967): if π(Γ) has (ε,K)-invariant vectors for all ε,K, then it has a true invariant vector. Examples: SL(n,ℤ) for n≥3, lattices in higher-rank groups. Property (T) implies property (FW) and Popa's rigidity results.
